title: The mark factorisation
teaches: Z/6 = Z/3 x Z/2, both axes measured

asserts.statement: The corpus's three rotation classes are the order of each mark's rotational symmetry group: infinite, 2, 1.
asserts.derivation: Sampled each mark as a point set and rotated it; 6/6 agreement with the stated trichotomy. A sine is odd, so a half-turn returns it -- which is why Wave groups with Line.

asserts.statement: The mark polarity axis is curvature class: zero or singular curvature vs smooth non-zero curvature.
asserts.derivation: Largest discrete turning angle along each stroke; 6/6 against the corpus's stated split. Point 0 (0-dim), Line 0 (straight), Angle 33.7 (corner), Curve/Wave/Circle 0.75-8.5 (smooth). This is the `singularity` shape axis of notes 022-026.

asserts.statement: The six marks are 3 symmetry classes x 2 curvature classes, every cell filled once; Z/6 = Z/3 x Z/2.
asserts.derivation: Both factors are now derived: symmetry order (F85) and curvature class (F88). Crossing them is a bijection, 6/6.

asserts.statement: The six marks are complete WITH RESPECT TO SYMMETRY ORDER: every order the corpus uses is either a mark's own or is produced by composition.
asserts.derivation: Iterated superposition-with-rotation reaches every C_n, verified by construction for n=2..8 from the C1 Angle alone. Triangle (C3) and the hexagram (C6) are therefore produced, not posited. Closure was also tested and does NOT reach C3 -- a chevron closes to an isoceles triangle, which is C1.
asserts.scope: Covers symmetry order only. Does NOT establish that every figure the corpus draws is reachable -- matching an order is weaker than being the same figure. Two figures are now known unreachable, for two different reasons: the Spiral wants scaling (spiral-requires-scaling) and the teardrop wants a curved join (teardrop-reachability, F123). Neither wants a seventh mark.

carries_undetermined.statement: The Spiral is not reachable by any attested operator, and the reason is not a missing scale parameter: it needs MODULATION -- varying a parameter along a mark's own extent -- which is a different operator family from placement.
carries_undetermined.scope: Measured over the 186 enumerated depth-2 combinations, not proved for all compositions. Margin is 0.111 and the nearest case is a near-degenerate stroke. TWO EARLIER INVARIANTS FAILED and are kept on the record: curvature-per-sample (spiral measured 0.95, flat, indistinguishable from a circle) and radial monotonicity (0.967 vs 0.927, contaminated by component stacking order).
